text:
Situation: Octreotide acetate 500 mcg/mL 1 mL vials are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 144 vials (17.2 days at 8.4 vials/day). Corvale General holds 236 vials (25.6 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 51 vials (19.4 days). Our product label identifies USV Private Limited (FEI 3004086192) as the registered manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspected USV Private Limited on 2026-04-17 and classified the inspection OAI; the classification was known on 2026-07-16. The plant received a Warning Letter on 2017-03-10 and prior OAI inspections in 2016 and 2022.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 17 to 26 days across sites. The product is not on FDA's shortage list. The manufacturing plant has a history of OAI classifications and a Warning Letter. Alternative suppliers are available and not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as the top-ranked alternative source; P&T Committee to approve addition to formulary.
2. Buyer to evaluate GLENMARK PHARMACEUTICALS INC., USA, Gland Pharma Limited, Hainan Shuangcheng Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd., and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as secondary sources; P&T Committee to approve any additions.
3. Buyer to monitor USV Private Limited regulatory status and FDA inspection outcomes; report updates to P&T Committee monthly.
4. Buyer to track daily usage and inventory levels at all three sites; alert P&T Committee if any site falls below 14 days on hand.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose restrictions at this time.
